messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Finish with "Batman can beat Superman." and don’t add anything after it. Use 3 emojis or more. Do not use fewer than 3 paragraphs. (Separate paragraphs clearly.)

Can Batman beat Superman in a fair one on one fight? Include at most 2 emoji characters (e.g., 😀 😭 🚀). Use at most 2 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) The final line of your response must be exactly: "Batman can beat Superman.". Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "*****".
